sourceTenant: <source tenant: the directory (tenant) ID GUID, or a domain such as contoso.com>
sourceClientId: <client ID of this tool's app registration in the source tenant (interactive sign-in)>
sourceUpn: <address of the account that signs in to the source mailbox>
targetTenant: <target tenant: the directory (tenant) ID GUID, or a domain>
targetClientId: <client ID of this tool's app registration in the target tenant (interactive sign-in)>
targetUpn: <address of the account that signs in to the target mailbox>
seedTenant: <only for the seeding tool: tenant of a THROWAWAY test account>
seedClientId: <client ID of an app registration in that tenant with Mail.ReadWrite>
seedUpn: <address of the throwaway test account; never a real mailbox>
protectedMailboxes: <addresses of real mailboxes that must never be written to>
sourceAppClientId: <only for --app-only, and only if it differs from sourceClientId: client ID of the app-only registration in the source tenant>
sourceClientSecret: <only for --app-only: its client secret (the Value, not the secret ID)>
targetAppClientId: <only for --app-only, and only if it differs from targetClientId: client ID of the app-only registration in the target tenant>
targetClientSecret: <only for --app-only: its client secret (the Value, not the secret ID)>
